text.p: Prince Bertil, the grand old man of Sweden's royal family, died on Sunday at the age of 84, the Swedish royal court announced.
The royal palace said Bertil, who was fourth in line to the Swedish throne after King Carl XVI Gustaf, died in his sleep at his Stockholm home.
Bertil was the son of King Gustaf Adolf VI, who died in 1973, and was immensely popular in Sweden. He had been frail for several years.
He spent 33 years keeping his relationship with divorced British actress Lilian Craig a secret to avoid a scandal that could have damaged the Swedish monarchy.
Prince Bertil and Lilian were eventually married at a ceremony in the Drottningholm Castle church outside Stockholm in 1976.
